phases.name: Slice-01: zero-JS WhatsApp anchor on the home top card
phases.description: One tap on the home top card opens WhatsApp with the full section-10 Spanish call as a plain wa.me/?text= anchor rendered at publish time. R5 settled PASS: the anchor ships. Final wiring needs a two-line slot seam in RankedList.astro, owned by a concurrent lane (see 01-04 notes).

steps.name: Pure Spanish call-message composer with template laws
criteria: Pure function maps a populated day-summary to the exact five-line section-10 Spanish template; no I/O, no clock, no ambient reads.
Vocabulary from canonical es constants: size band, wind, confidence; score_q rendered as-is; window start and end verbatim; no em dashes.
Property: output never contains braces, brackets, internal field names, model names, NaN, null, or English filler for any populated input.
Property: exactly five non-empty lines opening SURF, Mejor:, size-wind-window, Confianza, then the link line.
steps.scenario_name: El mensaje y la página cuentan la misma historia, sin texto técnico
steps.non_visual_rationale: Pure message composition; the visible surface ships in 01-03/01-04, which carry the charter and the U1-U7 checks.
steps.implementation_notes: TEST PARADIGM (mandatory, adapted): unit tests are property-based with fast-check (house style: tests/unit/scoring-laws.test.ts); example-based tests are fallback only with a documented reason; integration/E2E stay single-example. Adapted from the Hypothesis wording because this repo is TypeScript + fast-check. DISPATCH: project CLAUDE.md selects @nw-functional-software-crafter for every DELIVER step; the agent field above uses the schema-valid name, the orchestrator maps it. SEAMS (import-only, never modify): src/data/size-bands.ts exports the canonical es band labels; src/data/region.ts spotById gives the display name; src/publish/display-format.ts has formatSizeEs/formatBestWindowEs. Wind (limpio/picado/destrozado) and confidence (alta/media/baja) es words per section 10: define once in src/share (src/i18n/strings.ts belongs to another lane; FLAG the future consolidation, and FLAG-not-fix the pre-existing duplicate maps inside RankedList.astro). Input type is the DaySummary of src/data/forecast.ts plus spot name, fecha, and the link line from 01-02. Message shape the acceptance oracle decodes: SURF {fecha} / Mejor: {spot}, {score} / {tamano} y {viento}. {ventana}. / Confianza {nivel}. / {url}?b={build_id}.

steps.name: Share link derived from configured site and build stamp
criteria: Link origin comes from the Astro site configuration passed in as a parameter; no hostname literal anywhere under src/share.
Build stamp derives from published_at as b_YYYY-MM-DDTHHZ, the existing pipeline P1 contract; no second stamp format is invented.
Property: for any configured site and publish time, the link is absolute https, origin equals the configured site, ending in its ?b= stamp.
Property: the wa.me href decodes its text parameter back to the exact composed message.
steps.scenario_name: La dirección del mensaje sigue a la configuración del sitio, nunca a un nombre fijo
steps.non_visual_rationale: Pure URL derivation; the visible surface ships in 01-03/01-04, which carry the charter and the U1-U7 checks.
steps.implementation_notes: TEST PARADIGM (mandatory, adapted): property-based with fast-check as in 01-01. site is ALREADY configured in astro.config.mjs (verified: https://d1j9u9fxnap4es.cloudfront.net); components read Astro.site and pass it down as a plain string parameter so the functions stay pure and the config-repoint acceptance scenario passes with zero component edits. Stamp: b_ + published_at date + T + UTC hour + Z, exactly the production format at src/pipeline/build.ts:119 and the P1 header contract; derive it from forecast.published_at, do NOT mint a second format and do NOT touch src/pipeline/** (forbidden lane). wa.me carrier per the R5 product fact recorded in distill/red-classification.md: number-less https://wa.me/?text= returns 200 and redirects to api.whatsapp.com/send with type=custom_url; the anchor SHIPS, no clipboard fallback in this slice (that is slice-02).

steps.name: ShareControls anchor component, world-class at 390 px
criteria: Component emits exactly one plain anchor carrying the prewritten wa.me href and a Spanish accessible name; zero JavaScript shipped.
Target at least 44 px on both axes; type at least 16 px; the longest Spanish spot name fits 390 px untruncated.
Scoped styles use named tokens only, no raw hex; text clears 4.5:1 against the real backdrop in both themes.
Nothing animates or transitions on the control, so reduced motion changes nothing; no loading or skeleton states beside published data.
steps.scenario_name: La acción de compartir se ve terminada y respeta las preferencias del teléfono
steps.non_visual_rationale: Emits src/components/ShareControls.astro but mounts it nowhere; step 01-04 is the one that wires it into the home page. The U1-U7 checks and Vera both drive the BUILT page, so at this step they measure a surface that does not exist and fail by construction, not by defect. Verified 2026-08-09: des-verify-ui returned FAIL on all seven, and grep confirmed ShareControls is referenced by no page, layout or component. Reclassified by the orchestrator; the visible gate moved intact to 01-04.
steps.implementation_notes: EXEMPT FROM PARADIGM: single-shot publish-time component render; compensated by the property-based tests on the composer and link modules (01-01, 01-02). The render test uses Astro's container API to assert one anchor, href shape, and accessible name. Props: the composed message href plus label; the component does nothing but render (functional codebase rule). Styles: a scoped style block inside the .astro file using existing named tokens from src/styles/tokens.css (imported by Base already); src/styles/** is another lane's, do not edit it. Astro inlines small scoped styles, so no render-blocking subresource appears; U7's matched-rule check requires at least one rule targeting the anchor. Anchor budget roughly 120 B gz plus the urlencoded message in the href, inside the 14 KB gz home ceiling (verified by 01-04's gate run).

steps.name: Wire anchor into home top card, suite green
criteria: Built home shows the single WhatsApp anchor inside the top card; the whole slice-01 acceptance suite exits 0, exit captured to file.
Message composes from the same forecast days[0] top entry that renders the card; one data path, one vocabulary.
Home document at or under 14336 B gz through npm run build's page-weight gate; anchor budget roughly 120 B gz.
With JavaScript disabled the identical anchor and message remain; the address derives from the site config, never localhost or a hardcoded host.
steps.scenario_name: Un toque abre WhatsApp con el llamado del día ya escrito
steps.u8_observation: Un toque en la acción de WhatsApp de la tarjeta grande abre WhatsApp con el mensaje completo ya escrito: SURF y la fecha, Mejor: con el spot y su puntaje, el tamaño y el viento, la ventana, Confianza con el nivel, y una dirección https que termina en ?b= con el sello del build. El mismo enlace y el mismo mensaje con JavaScript apagado.
steps.implementation_notes: BLOCKER, COORDINATE BEFORE STARTING: the acceptance oracle requires the anchor INSIDE ol.ranked > li:first-child, and that markup is owned entirely by src/components/RankedList.astro, a forbidden file another lane holds concurrently, with no slot today. Required seam, two lines in RankedList.astro: render {index === 0 && <slot name="top-card-actions" />} inside the first li. Then index.astro passes <ShareControls slot="top-card-actions" ... /> as a child of <RankedList locale="es" day={0}> and every share-specific decision stays in this lane. The orchestrator must either have the owning lane land that slot first or amend this lane's boundary for that serialized two-line edit; this step is BLOCKED until one happens. REJECTED alternatives, do not build them: (a) forking the home markup into index.astro silently detaches the home from the concurrent RankedList work, a collision without a git conflict; (b) string-transforming the rendered slot HTML inside Base.astro couples the layout to another lane's DOM shape and breaks silently when they refactor. AFTER GREEN: run the suite with output redirected to a file and $? captured, never piped (repo has committed over a red gate that way); then npm run build and inspect dist/index.html; then the orchestrator runs des-verify-ui and dispatches the source-blind examiner with only the charter and start recipe; COMMIT is refused until both records pass. Integration test level: single-example by design (paradigm directive: E2E verifies wiring, not invariants).
